domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers how to gather and define client needs, establish document specifications, set page size, margins, bleed, and create project plans before building an InDesign file, including workflow considerations and file organization.

Focuses on the InDesign interface, workspace customization, tool panels, preferences, and core functions such as creating documents, using master pages, and managing templates. Mastery enables efficient navigation and setup for any layout project.

Covers text frame creation, threading, applying paragraph and character styles, kerning, tracking, leading, glyphs, ligatures, and advanced typographic features like drop caps, numbering, and text variables. Emphasis on precise typographic control for print and digital output.

Focuses on placing, linking, and embedding images, using the Links panel, adjusting resolution, applying effects, working with transparency, color swatches, gradients, and managing vector graphics. Includes best practices for image preparation and color management.

Encompasses preparing documents for print, setting printer's marks, bleeds, and color separations, exporting to PDF, EPUB, HTML, and JPEG, and using preflight tools. Also covers digital publishing options and workflow integration with Creative Cloud.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early, bring a valid ID, and ensure a stable internet connection for the online proctor. Review the exam timer, answer all 40 questions, and double‑check any performance tasks before submitting. Keep calm and manage time wisely.

faq.answer_text: The 9A0-413 exam consists of 40 questions, combining multiple‑choice items and performance‑based tasks that assess practical InDesign skills. All questions must be answered within the allotted time.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: A candidate must achieve at least 66 % correct responses to pass the Adobe Certified Professional – InDesign exam. Scores are calculated from the weighted domains and reported immediately after completion.
The exam is a linear, computer‑based test lasting 50 minutes. During this time you will answer all 40 items, and the timer is visible on screen.

The standard price for the 9A0-413 exam is $180 when booked through Certiport or Pearson VUE, as noted in Adobe’s official exam guide. Additional fees may apply for rescheduling or retakes, so verify current pricing on the testing provider’s site.

methodology.summary: Content was compiled from Adobe’s official exam guides, cross‑referenced with the InDesign User Guide archive, and organized by domain weight to reflect the exam’s structure. Sources are cited for verification.

editorial.overview: Adobe’s 9A0-413 exam validates the Adobe Certified Professional – InDesign credential. Candidates answer 40 multiple‑choice and performance‑based tasks within a 50‑minute, linear computer‑based test. The exam measures ability to set project requirements, navigate InDesign’s interface, apply typography and graphic techniques, and prepare files for print or digital publishing. A score of 66 % or higher is required to pass.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review Adobe’s official InDesign user guide and focus on each domain’s weight. Practice creating documents, applying paragraph and character styles, and exporting PDFs within the 50‑minute time limit using sample projects. Use Certiport’s practice tests to become familiar with multiple‑choice format and performance tasks. Track progress against the 13 % to 30 % domain weights, and schedule the exam when comfortable with all areas.
editorial.who_should_take: Graphic designers, layout artists, and publishing professionals with at least a year of hands‑on InDesign experience should take this exam to demonstrate proficiency in document creation, typography, image integration, and export workflows.

exam_price_notes: Standard price $180 via Certiport or Pearson VUE.
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. ACP exams include both multiple-choice questions and performance-based tasks in a simulated application environment. AD0-E series exams are multiple-choice only.
id_requirements: One government-issued photo ID with full name. Name must match registration exactly.

official_study_resources.notes: Official exam guides and study materials available on Adobe Learning
official_study_resources.title: Adobe Certification Exam Guides

prerequisites.description: No formal prerequisites; proficiency with Adobe InDesign recommended

renewal_options: ACP (Creative Cloud) certifications are version-specific and do not expire but may become outdated with new software versions. Adobe Experience Cloud certifications (AD0-E series) are valid for 2 years; renewal by passing a current renewal exam at no charge.

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake. Third and subsequent attempts require 14-day waiting period.

testing_centers.notes: ACP (Creative Cloud) exams delivered via Certiport at authorized test centers.
Adobe Experience Cloud professional/expert exams (AD0-E series) delivered via Pearson VUE. Online proctoring available.
